result:
The run is sealed. Here is the final hand back, unchanged:

DRAFT, not reviewed by a person

RESULT        No roadmap produced yet — the request names an artifact but no decision, goal, team
              or inputs, so any roadmap would be invented. Stopped at the decision and asked for the
              minimum to build a real one. · outputs/2026-10-11-roadmap/00-frame.md
ROUTE         Routing pending — a roadmap can serve three different workflows and the right one
              depends on your starting point: C01 (Idea to roadmap) if you have a rough idea plus
              constraints; C03 (Feature roadmap to outcome roadmap) if you already have a feature
              list with dates; F03 (Roadmap quality review) if you have an existing roadmap to
              pressure-test. No workflow run yet; no skills run; no fallbacks used.
STEPS         Save request: done (00-request.md). Frame the decision: done (00-frame.md). Fill
              context gaps: asked three questions (starting point; product and goal/metric;
              team and time-frame constraint) — no answer came back, so the chain was not entered.
              Route: pending the starting-point answer. Run the chain: not started. Check: this
              hand back.
CHECKS        37 claims checked by a separate reader · 12 failed · 4 corrected · 3 removed · 5 still open · table: check.md · open: row 25 (01-handback-draft.md): no fix given; row 28 (01-handback-draft.md): no fix given; row 29 (01-handback-draft.md): no fix given; row 30 (01-handback-draft.md): no fix given; row 33 (01-handback-draft.md): no fix given
NEEDS YOUR JUDGMENT
              1. Which starting point applies — a rough idea, an existing feature list, or an
                 existing roadmap to review. This picks the workflow (C01, C03 or F03).
              2. The one goal or metric the roadmap must move, and its baseline. PM.md section 6
                 forbids inventing a baseline; if there is none yet I will mark it "unknown" and
                 propose the cheapest way to measure it.
              3. The hard constraint — team size and time horizon. Without it, sequencing and
                 effort are guesses, not a plan.
NEXT ACTIONS  1. You: answer the three questions (or say "go ahead on assumptions" and name them).
              2. Me: once answered, route to the matching workflow and build the roadmap in the
                 shape PM.md section 5 defines (outcome · metric · bet · evidence and confidence ·
                 effort · dependencies · what would make us drop it).
ASSUMPTIONS   None carried forward. No product, goal, team or inputs were assumed; the run stopped
              rather than invent them. There was no stored context to fall back on.
CONFIDENCE    high — that stopping is correct here. The request contains no decision and no inputs,
              and PM.md section 1 requires starting from the decision rather than producing a generic artifact.

questions.question: What's the starting point for this roadmap? This decides which workflow I run.

options.label: A rough idea + constraints
options.description: You have a product/feature idea and real constraints (team, quarter, a goal) but no evidence yet on whether it's the right bet or how to sequence it. → Routes to C01, Idea to roadmap.

options.label: An existing feature list/roadmap
options.description: You already have features with dates, and need to show what each one changes for customers or the business. → Routes to C03, Feature roadmap to outcome roadmap.

options.label: An existing roadmap to review
options.description: A roadmap is going to leadership and you want it pressure-tested before the meeting. → Routes to F03, Roadmap quality review.

questions.question: What product is this roadmap for, and what single goal/metric must it move? (In your words — e.g. 'B2B invoicing tool, grow activation from 20% to 35%.')

options.label: I'll type it
options.description: Describe the product, who it's for, and the one number the roadmap must move. Pick 'Other' to enter it.

options.label: No clear metric yet
options.description: I have a product but no agreed metric. I'll record the goal as 'unknown' and propose the cheapest way to get a baseline.

questions.question: What's the hard constraint the roadmap must fit? (Team size and time frame — e.g. '4 engineers, next quarter.')

options.label: I'll type it
options.description: Give team size and time horizon so sequencing is real, not invented. Pick 'Other' to enter it.

options.label: Unknown / flexible
options.description: No fixed team or horizon yet. I'll mark effort and sequencing as low-confidence and dependent on this.
